svg.title: fnc-fogger · ESP32-C3 wiring · GPIO3 gate · firmware 3.4.2
svg.desc: Six panels show 24V power with a 5V buck converter, ESP32-C3 pin connections, parallel I2C sensors, Noctua fan pinout, IRLB8721 fogger switching and implemented firmware behavior. Component illustrations are embedded; all wiring and labels are vector elements. Gate GPIO3, PWM GPIO5, tach GPIO6, SDA GPIO0, SCL GPIO1.

g.text: HIGH = ON · LOW = OFF · gate-source pull-down needed
Complete 5V fogger module with its own driver.
• Fan PWM / RPM + manual fogger output
• Startup: fan 3 s, fogger pulses 100 ms ON / OFF
• Manual commands expire after 30 s without renewal
• First installation: USB · later updates: OTA
REV 06 · 11 Nov 2026 · Editable vector wiring + embedded component artwork · Firmware mapping: GPIO3 / GPIO5 / GPIO6
Check board pinout, load currents and insulation. Component artwork is illustrative; verify the actual hardware.
